tablet.notes:
Faster screens: saving your message history no longer makes the screens wait, and a history sync no longer floods the screen with refreshes. This should cut the lag between screens.
Forwarding fixes: forwarding a video to several chats no longer freezes the app, a failed upload now shows Not sent instead of Sending forever, and a file that can't be read is no longer silently dropped.
Since the last update: messages that showed twice after the phone's history sync stay hidden, and new groups start their own group.

tablet-regular.notes:
Hold a message: the whole screen goes soft, emoji reactions sit above it and a card of actions below (Forward, Copy, Delete, Select more, Info), like Google Messages. Select more and the Details page match too.
The keyboard closes after you send and when you swipe through the messages. The voice recorder is much smaller. The tablet icon on messages another tablet sent no longer goes missing.
Fixed a crash when opening a video that had been downloaded ahead.
Since the last update: bubbles stop at about three quarters of the width.

messageplus.notes:
Group texts that someone else starts now show up on the tablet as their own group, right away.
Messages no longer show up twice on the tablet, and reinstalling Message+ no longer re-sends old pictures and group messages.
A text with a line break or tab is no longer lost, a text from the tablet is never sent twice, and a text the carrier refuses now shows "Not sent".
Blocking and muting now work the same on the phone and the tablet.
New fast sync: "Sync messages" and "Sync attachments" send everything at once, with progress in percent on the phone, the tablet and the dashboard.

messageplus_previous.notes: Voicemail: after you sign in to voicemail again, the tablet no longer keeps saying the flip phone is signed out. The phone now tells the tablet right after you sign in and after every successful check.

tablet2.notes:
Fixes messages showing twice after the phone's history sync, and makes opening the app with a large message history much faster (the cleanup of those copies no longer scans every message again and again).
Also in this copy: the Performance log (Settings > Performance log), and group texts from a new group start their own group.
